results.name: Launch in Flight
results.description: The launch vehicle has lifted off from the launchpad.

results.name: Payload Deployed
results.description: Deployment of the payload(s) has been confirmed.

results.name: To Be Confirmed
results.description: Awaiting official confirmation - current date is known with some certainty.

results.name: Go for Launch
results.description: Current T-0 confirmed by official or reliable sources.

results.name: Launch Successful
results.description: The launch vehicle successfully inserted its payload(s) into the target orbit(s).

results.name: Launch Failure
results.description: Either the launch vehicle did not reach orbit, or the payload(s) failed to separate.

results.name: On Hold
results.description: The countdown has been paused, but the launch can still happen within the launch window.

results.name: Launch was a Partial Failure
results.description: Either the launch vehicle reached orbit but did not deliver its payload in the targeted orbit, or an exceptional event made it impossible to consider the mission a success.

results.name: To Be Determined
results.description: Current date is a placeholder or rough estimation based on unreliable or interpreted sources.
